title: CGLIB advice sees a checked exception before the caller receives its wrapper
summary: CGLIB advice now sees the original undeclared checked exception. The caller still receives its wrapper, and type-specific advice can recover normally.

change.description: An advised class-based proxy moves wrapping of an undeclared checked exception to the generated proxy boundary. Advice can once again classify the exception thrown by the target.

notes: The caller and interceptor compare the exact exception objects. A JDK proxy and declared and unchecked failures supply controls.
